coverage: The exact Apps frontend candidate is built, packed and installed by the managed Portal lifecycle.
Portal maps the app-bound scheduled-digest.run handler to the fixed POST /v1/tasks/digest route. No payload can select a path, destination or arbitrary handler.
The native ready backend receives the signed service-task command, checks the current app/generation/policy/release service identity and returns a bounded digest result.
The native worker completes the digest task without a browser or viewer; exact occurrence replay creates no second task and changed bytes under the same occurrence conflict.

The Apps service independently tests persisted idempotent digest state, duplicate replay and changed-identity refusal. The frontend tests current backend state, host navigation, locale changes and credential-name-only network access.
The managed lifecycle still passes current-viewer gating, reviewed event delivery, uninstall clear and fresh reinstall.
limits: The full native Portal matrix uses the contract-compatible ready backend for the managed runtime. The exact scheduled-digest service image is built and tested in Apps CI but is not yet the native runtime image.
A neutral clean-market walkthrough installing both Notes and Scheduled Digest and opening both from My Apps remains outstanding.
Update-generation service-task registration variants, production deployment and protocol freeze remain gated.
